geometry: Reuse the original closed beveled-ingot family from #656, normalized to each unchanged original icon width.
materials: Read-only selection of fully opaque top-face pixels in each existing owned ingot PNG. Native shader UVs point to these original pixels; no raster is modified, generated, recolored or copied.
sampling: Largest axis-aligned rectangle with alpha >=250 inside the existing icon top-face quadrilateral [(82,17),(108,32),(45,91),(20,75)]. Stored rectangles remain editable source data. The final UV rectangle is inset by one pixel on every side to keep bilinear sampling inside opaque source pixels.
image_generation: None. Original project attribution and provenance remain with the existing icons.
exclusions: No new material type, balancing, tier artwork policy, external assets or rejected mate art.
